ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ১৯) The earliest prose of English Literature "The Anglo-Saxon Chronicle" was composed by -
ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
♦ The Anglo-Saxon Chronicle:
- It is the earliest prose of English Literature.
- It is composed by King Alfred the Great.

• King Alfred the Great:  
- He is the founder of English prose.
- He prevented England from falling to the Danes and promoted learning and literacy.

ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ২০) Who composed the famous literary work “Piers Plowman”?
ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
♦ Piers Plowman:
- Piers Plowman, in full The Vision of Piers Plowman, Middle English alliterative poem presumed to have been written by William Langland.
• Three versions of Piers Plowman are extant:
- the poem’s short early form, dating from the 1360s;
- a major revision and extension of A made in the late 1370s; and
- a less “literary” version of B dating from the 1380s and apparently intended to focus the work’s doctrinal issues.
- Some scholars think that version C may not be entirely attributable to Langland.

Source: Britannica

- সে Othello কে বলে যে Desdemona তার প্রতি unfaithful.

- Othello gave a handkerchief to his lover Desdemona as symbol of love.
